prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1352; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give the facts of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, but I still need your name for the file.
A: Understood. It's the person you have listed on the claim.
Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what you were doing right before the collision?
A: I was driving in the right lane on the main road, heading toward the shopping center. I signaled to move into the left lane because I needed to get over for a turn coming up.
Q: Did you check your mirrors and blind spot before changing lanes?
A: I checked the mirror and I glanced over my shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I started to move over.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other vehicle was in the left lane, a bit back, and then it was suddenly right next to me. Our side mirrors touched and I felt my car shove sideways. I braked and pulled onto the shoulder.
Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?
A: Not right away. About an hour later my right shoulder started hurting badly, and by the next morning I could barely lift my arm above my chest.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the following day and they recommended an imaging appointment. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?
A: I don't believe so. The other driver stopped briefly and then left the area before the police arrived.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Only that my car has damage along the passenger side and I'd like the repair handled quickly.
Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with the repair shop and your medical providers. This concludes the statement.
